description: Rewrite a conversation to reclaim tokens with deterministic strategies (dedupe, trim stale tool results, strip base64; prune-history is optional and lossy). Returns the slimmed JSON and a savings summary; no LLM calls. Results over 100k chars are not echoed back (summary and a CLI command instead). Use after profile_context finds waste the user wants fixed. Add prune-history only with the user's consent, then write the replacement summary as the result instructs.

conversation.description: Conversation JSON (OpenAI or Anthropic format, or bare message array)

keep_recent.description: Messages at the tail to leave untouched (default 6; 0 = none; prune-history keeps at least 2)

max_tool_result_tokens.description: Token budget for trimmed tool results (default 300)

strategies.description: Default: dedupe, trim-tool-results, strip-base64. Add trim-tool-calls for big inline file writes, prune-history for lossy compaction of old turns.

name: optimize_context
